newsitem.title: USA: Data Research leaves executive spot open.
newsitem.headline: Data Research leaves executive spot open.

text.p: Data Research Associates Inc said Wednesday it will not immediately fill the position of vice president vacated by Thomas Rafferty.

The company said Rafferty had resigned to pursue other interests after three years with the computer systems integrator and that President and Chief Executive Officer Michael Mellinger will assume direct control of the projects Rafferty was working on at the time of his departure.
Data Research provides its services to libraries and other information providers.
Its shares were down 5/8 Wednesday at 14-3/8.
